newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly down in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly down in active trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished weaker but off earlier lows after late selling of the U.S. dollar driven by a bullish stock market, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.495 compared with an intra-day low of T$27.520 and Monday's T$27.490 finish. Turnover was an active US$219.5 million.

The Taiwan dollar opened lower to reflect the strong U.S. dollar in overseas markets in the morning, but an active stock market at home triggered selling on the American currency for Taiwan dollar liquidity, dealers said.
The stock market reported an active turnover of T$125.9 billion on Tuesday.
"With the heavy stock market turnover, there is limited room for the Taiwan dollar to fall even the U.S. dollar is strong in overseas markets," said one dealer at a foreign banks.
A T$27.49-T$27.52 trading range was seen in the near term.
